about_the_game:
Master gravity (or crash trying) in Slingshot Pilot! Pull off risky maneuvers, dodge asteroids, and complete crazy missions to rank up in the corp, and get riskier and shadier assignments. Compete versus peers in the highscore chase but dont fly too close to the sun..

Try the Demo now!

The Slingshot Pilot demo gives you a taste of the action! Take on a handful of missions, experiment with gravity-powered flight, and get a feel for the fast, arcade-style gameplay. You’ll crash, you’ll learn, and you’ll pull off some incredible maneuvers along the way. So hop in, have fun, and see if you’ve got what it takes to become a top pilot!
